target: 602 “Chirurgia”

source: 602 “Surgery”
target: 602 “Chirurgia”

source: Lugano’s eyes remained open as he swung open the door to the suite, his gaze vacant.
target: Oculi Lugani aperti remanuerunt, dum ostium ad conclave patefeceret, vultus eius vacuus.

source: He stepped into the deserted corridor, where only the sound of crashing waves reverberated.
target: Ingrediebat in coridorio deserto, ubi solus sonus fluctuum ruentium resonabat.

source: In this moment, everyone, save for the sailor on night duty, succumbed to slumber.
target: In hoc momento, omnes, nisi nauta in nocturna servitio, sopore ceciderunt.

source: Lugano moved forward, the kerosene wall lamps around him casting an ethereal glow that mingled with the encroaching darkness.
target: Lugano procedebat; lumina parietalia kerosina circum eum fulgorem aetherium efferebant, qui cum imminentibus tenebris miscebatur.

source: He reached the end of the floor and halted in front of a vivid vermilion wooden door.
target: Ad finem pavimenti pervenit et coram ianuam ligneam vividam rubram sistit.

source: Creak. The door groaned open, and the darkness within seemed to swallow every trace of light.
target: Crepitus. Ianuam gemens aperta est, et obscuritas intus omnem vestigium lucis vorari videbatur.

source: Lugano traversed the obscurity with a blank expression, entering the room.
target: Lugano obscuritatem perambulavit vultu inano, in conclave ingrediens.

source: Behind him, the vermilion door was pulled shut by an imperceptible force.
target: Post eum, ianuam rubeam, vis imperceptibilis eam claudens, retracta est.

source: It was a suite.
target: Conclave erat.

source: The living and dining areas lay shrouded in darkness, devoid of any candlelit glow.
target: Regiones ad vivendum et cenandum in obscuritate latebant, absque aliqua luce candelarum.

source: The faint crimson moonlight filtered through the curtains, offering minimal visibility.
target: Lumen lunaris rubrum leviter per cortinas infusum, parvam visibilitatem praebebat.

source: At the dining table stood two shadowy figures.
target: Ad mensam cenandi duo figurae umbratiles stabant.

source: One of them appeared aged, with mostly gray hair and dark, deep blue eyes that seemed to absorb the night.
target: Unus ex ipsis senectutem ostendebat, capillis fere canis et oculis obscuris, profundis caeruleis, qui noctem devorare videbantur.

source: Despite the wrinkles at the corners of his eyes, the elder’s skin remained well-maintained, adorned in a loose, dark-black robe.
target: Non obstante rugis in angulis oculorum eius, cutis senis bene curata erat, induta in veste laxae nigerrimae.

source: Beside him stood Enio, the brown-haired, brown-eyed patient who had intruded upon Lugano that night, his pale face devoid of life.
target: Iuxta eum stabat Enio, aegrotus cum capillis fuscis et oculis fuscis, qui illa nocte Lugani intravit, facie pallida sine vita.

source: His vacant gaze fixated on the unadorned table.
target: Vultus eius vacuus in mensa non ornata fixus erat.

source: Lugano, as if sleepwalking, stood next to Enio, unusually quiet.
target: Lugano, quasi somnambulans, iuxta Enion stetit, miris silentio.

source: The elder in the loose black robe turned his head, fixing his gaze on Enio.
target: Senex in veste nigra laxae caput convertit atque vultum in Enion ferefixit.

source: The patient ambled towards the dining table, climbed on it, and lay completely motionless.
target: Aegrotus ad mensam cenandi ambulavit, ascendit eam, et omnino immobilis iacebat.

source: The blond elder brandished a sharp scalpel, unfastening Enio’s tweed coat, cashmere sweater, and cotton shirt.
target: Senex flavus acutum scalpellum extulit, solvens vestem Enii confectam ex mixto textu (tweed, cashmere, et cotone).

source: He pressed the razor-sharp blade against Enio’s chest, producing a ripping sound as he sliced through layers of flesh, creating a long wound.
target: Premens laminae acutissimae in pectus Enii, sonum lacerationis edidit, dum per stratos carnis secabat, longum vulnus creans.

source: As Enio’s chest and abdominal cavity lay exposed to the crimson moonlight, a void greeted the eye.
target: Cum pectus et cavitas abdominalis Enii sub lumine lunaris rubri patefacta erant, vacuum oculum salutavit.

source: No stomach, no lungs, no small or large intestines, liver, or kidneys.
target: Nullus stomachus, nulli pulmones, nec intestina parva aut magna, nec iecur, nec renes.

source: Only a weakly beating bright red heart, accompanied by a few blood vessels extending from it.
target: Solum cor rubrum, debiliter pulsans, cum paucis vasculis sanguineis ex quo procedebant.

source: With a swift motion, the old man in the dark-black robe manipulated the scalpel, his other hand flickering with a faint light as he pressed down.
target: Celeriter, senex in veste nigra laxae scalpellum movebat, altera manus leviter luce micante, dum premebat.

source: In a sequence too rapid for the eye to follow, he withdrew the still-beating heart in his left hand.
target: In serie nimis celeriter facta, ut oculis sequeri non posset, cor adhuc pulsans manu sinistra abstulit.

source: Enio’s chest and abdomen, now empty, displayed only a few non-bleeding blood vessels.
target: Pectus et abdomen Enii, iam vacua, ostenderunt solum pauca vasa sanguinea non effusa.

source: The old man closed the incision with a tight squeeze, sealing it with a flickering light.
target: Senex incisionem arcte complevit, luce micante sigillans.

source: Enio’s stomach returned to its original state, devoid of any scars.
target: Venter Enii ad statum originem redivit, absque ullis cicatricibus.

source: Throughout this extraordinary procedure, the special patient’s eyes remained open, as if untouched by the surgical ordeal.
target: Per hanc praeclaram operationem, oculi peculiaris aegroti aperti remanuerunt, quasi a chirurgico periculo immunes.

source: In that moment, he rolled off the dining table, ambled to the door, and exited the room.
target: In illo momento, de mensa cenandi volutus est, ad ianuam ambulavit, et conclave egressus est.

source: The old man opened his suitcase, revealing glass jars containing pale amber liquid, each cradling various organs: spleen, lungs, liver, kidneys, stomach, and intestines…
target: Senex sarcinam suam aperuit, revelans vasa vitrea quae liquidum ambrae pallidae continent, qua singula varia organa fovebant: lien, pulmones, iecur, renes, venter, et intestina…

source: Placing these items on the dining table in a peculiar order, surrounding the still gently beating scarlet heart, the old man in the loose black robe took a step back.
target: His rebus in mensa cenandi ordine insolito disposis, circum cor rubrum adhuc leniter pulsantem, senex in veste nigra laxae gradum retraxit.

source: He recited an ancient, malevolent, yet strangely intimate language.
target: Recitavit linguam antiquam, malevolam, sed admodum intimam.

source: As the unknown murmur resonated, the internal organs ascended slowly, upheld by an invisible force.
target: Dum ignotus murmur resonabat, organa interna lente ascendebant, a vis invisibili sustenta.

source: Their final positions varied, resembling the internal organs of a standing human.
target: Ultimae positiones eorum variabantur, simulantes organa interna hominis stantis.

source: The heart, liver, spleen, lungs, and kidneys emitted a faint glow simultaneously, outlining a form on the dining table.
target: Cor, iecur, lien, pulmones, et renes simul leviter fulgentes, formam in mensa cenandi delineantes.

source: It lacked a head, limbs, or bones, merely a corporeal essence that grew more defined.
target: Non habebat caput, membra, nec ossa; sola essentia corporalis, quae magis definita videbatur.

source: A baby’s cry echoed, faint yet tangible.
target: Clamor infanti resonabat, mollis sed perceptibilis.

source: However, the body distorted, squirmed, and disintegrated in the end.
target: Attamen, corpus deformatum, contorsum, et demum dispersum est.

source: The old man in the loose black robe sighed with regret.
target: Senex in veste nigra laxae cum paenitentia suspiravit.

source: Strangely, the wrinkles at the corners of his eyes were noticeably reduced, and much of his white hair had reverted to light gold.
target: Mire, rugae in angulis oculorum eius evidentissime reductae erant, et multa capilla alba ad aurum levem redierant.

source: In an instant, he appeared seven or eight years younger.
target: In momento, septem vel octo annos iunior videbatur.

source: Sensing his good condition, the elder turned his attention to Lugano.
target: Sensu bonae valetudinis, senex ad Luganum vertit.

source: Lugano, seemingly summoned, approached the dining table and lay down, awaiting with open eyes.
target: Lugano, quasi convocatus, ad mensam cenandi accessit et se iacuit, oculis apertis exspectans.

source: The elder unbuttoned Lugano’s linen shirt, took up the scalpel, and gestured as if deciding where to make the incision.
target: Senex tunicam linteam Lugani disabiguit, scalpellum extulit, et gestus fecit quasi statuturus ubique incisionem facere.

source: Suddenly, a loud bang reverberated.
target: Subito, sonitus ingens resonavit.

source: The vermilion door swung open, crashing into the wall.
target: Ianuam rubeam vibratam aperuit, percussa in parietem.

source: Crimson flames surged, illuminating the room, climbing the walls and ceiling, transforming the place into a fiery inferno.
target: Flammae rubrae eruptae sunt, conclave illuminantes, ascendentes parietes et laquearia, locum in ignipotens infernum convertentes.

source: Lumian, adorned in black hair, green eyes, a golden straw hat, a cotton shirt, a black vest, and dark pants, materialized at the door and entered the suite.
target: Lumian, ornatus capillis nigris, oculis viridibus, pileo stramineo aureo, tunica ex cotone, vestis nigra, et braccis obscuris, apparuit ad ianuam et conclave intravit.

source: He calmly addressed the old man in the loose black robe, “Don’t you know he’s my servant?”
target: Ille tranquille senem in veste nigra laxae alloquitur: “Nonne scis eum esse servum meum?”

source: The elder’s eyes narrowed as he readied the scalpel to descend towards Lugano’s neck.
target: Oculi senis angustati sunt, dum scalpellum ad collum Lugani descendere praeparabat.

source: However, his right hand refused to budge, seemingly restrained by an invisible force pushing it upward.
target: At, dextra manus eius non moveretur, quasi vi invisibili sursum eam impellens, continebatur.

source: In the midst of the rising crimson flames, Lumian paused, displaying no urgency to act.
target: In medio flammarum rubrarum oriturarum, Lumian cessavit, nec cupiditatem agendi festinationem ostendens.

source: He spoke with intrigue,
target: Ille, cum studio, locutus est:

source: “That surgery was quite fascinating—extracting internal organs while leaving the person alive, albeit gradually dying.
target: “Chirurgia illa valde fascinabat—organa interna extrahens, dum hominem vivum reliquit, licet paulatim moriens.

source: “And you used those organs for a ritual, rejuvenating yourself. Meanwhile, you nearly brought forth a peculiar lifeform.”
target: Et illa organa ad ritum usus es, te rejuvenans; interea, paene formam vitae peculiarem produxisti.”

source: Surprise flickered in the elder’s dark-blue eyes.
target: Mirum in oculis senis caeruleis micabat.

source: “How do you know?”
target: “Quomodo scis?”

source: Haven’t you just arrived in pursuit of your servant?
target: Nonne venisti modo ad quaerendum servum tuum?

source: And no one entered before you!
target: Et nemo ante te intravit!

source: Lumian emitted a soft chuckle.
target: Lumian submollim risum edidit.

source: “You don’t need to know.”
target: “Non necesse est tibi scire.”

source: I still have a few hours of Governor of the Sea authority.
target: Adhuc paucos horas potestate Gubernatoris Maris mihi restant.

source: Isn’t it easy to ‘see’ something in these waters?
target: Nonne facile est aliquid in his aquis conspicere?

source: Sensing Lumian’s confidence, certainty, ease, and absence of hostility, the elder fell silent briefly before expressing,
target: Sensu fiduciae, certitudinis, facilitasque et hostilitatis absentiae Lumiani, senex breviter tacuit, deinde dixit:

source: “Life is the most precious, so life becomes the finest sacrifice and ingredient.”
target: “Vita est pretiosissima, ergo vita fit optima sacrificium et elementum.”

source: He refrained from divulging details about the surgery or ritual, choosing instead to expound on his philosophy and the truth he sought.
target: Ab enarratione singularum de chirurgia aut ritu recusavit, potius suam philosophiam ac veritatem quaesitam explicans.

source: Praising and blaspheming life simultaneously? Lumian arched his eyebrows, finding it vaguely reminiscent of Lady Moon, Madame Night, and the bestowed of the Great Mother.
target: Vitā laudāns et simul blasphemandus? Lumian supercilia elevatis hoc vagi modo reminiscens invenit Dominae Lunae, Dominae Noctis, atque munera a Magna Matre concessa.

source: Carefully assessing the black-robed elder behind the dining table, Lumian, upon confirming his gender, temporarily set aside his sudden anxiety.
target: Caute aestimans senem in veste nigra post mensam cenandi, Lumian, genus eius confirmato, sollicitudinem subitam pro tempore deiecit.

source: Gazing down at the motionless Lugano on the dining table, Lumian casually inquired, “How did you control my servant?”
target: Aspiciens in Lugano immobili in mensa cenandi, Lumian familiari modo quaesivit: “Quomodo servum meum coercuisti?”

source: The elder fixed Lumian with a penetrating gaze, as if probing the depths of his intentions.
target: Senex Lumian oculis penetrantibus ferefixit, quasi arcana intentionum eius indagaret.

source: He pondered, weighing the decision to preach the truth or engage in a confrontation to eradicate the issue.
target: Cogitabat, deliberans utrum veritatem praedicaret aut in contentionem se immitteret ad quaestionem eradicandam.

source: After a brief silence, he spoke in a resonant voice,
target: Post brevem silentiam, voce resonante dixit,

source: “He’s a Blessed of the Great Mother. He heard the cries of the Son of God.”
target: “Est benedictus a Magna Matre. Clamores Filii Dei audivit.”

source: Great Mother? Lumian’s scalp tingled at the term.
target: Magna Mater? Lumiani caput leviter titillatus est ad hoc verbum.

source: Had it not been for the Sea Governor’s authority, Lumian would have launched a full-scale attack without allowing the elder a moment to react or explain.
target: Nisi propter auctoritatem Gubernatoris Maris, Lumian totum impetum intromitteret, nec seni momentum ad respondendum aut explicandum daret.

source: Regardless, even if he eliminated the elder, spirit channeling remained a viable option.
target: Quocumque modo, etsi senem eriperet, spiritus canalizatio optio manebat valida.

source: Moreover, the elder could be fed to Ludwig!
target: Praeterea, senem Ludwigo edendum tradi posset!

source: Though taken aback by the elder’s possible reference to Lugano as a Blessed of Earth Mother, Lumian swiftly dismissed the apparent meaning.
target: Quamquam senis, quod Lugano ut Benedictum Terrae Matris appellaret, obstupefactus, Lumian celeriter sensum apparentem reiecit.

source: He was certain that Lugano was human and harbored no unusual bloodlines.
target: Certus erat Luganum hominem esse et nullas stirpes insolitas gerere.

source: Following Lugano’s injury at Solow Motel, Jenna collected his splattered blood and conducted Magic Mirror Divination according to Lumian’s subsequent instructions.
target: Post vulnerationem Lugani apud Solow Motel, Jenna sanguinem eius sparsum collegit et Divinationem Speculi Magici, secundum praecepta Lumiani, perduxit.

source: In an instant, Lumian deciphered the elder’s true meaning.
target: In instante, Lumian veram significationem senis intellexit.

source: The Beyonders of the Planter pathway are all Blessed of the Great Mother?
target: Num omnes Beyonders semitae Planter benedicti a Magna Matre sunt?

source: Where does Earth Mother stand? Planter is the main pathway of the Church of Earth Mother…
target: Ubi stat Terra Mater? Planter est via principalis Ecclesiae Terrae Matris…

source: Could it be… the Great Mother reigns over multiple pathways, akin to the Celestial Worthy and Mr. Fool? Planter and Sower? The names bear a striking connection…
target: Num forte... Magna Mater super plures semitas regnat, instar Caelestis Digni et Domini Stulti? Planter et Sower? Nomina insigne conexa videntur.

source: As Lumian’s thoughts raced, his focus intensified on the existence of the Son of God.
target: Dum cogitationes Lumiani exactebantur, attentio eius in existentia Filii Dei intensior facta est.

source: Cordu’s empty infant cradle and the honorific title of Lady Moon nurturing a deity flooded his mind.
target: Cordu vacua cunabulum infantis et honorificus titulus Dominae Lunae, deum fovens, mentem eius inundaverunt.

source: Dammit, why is it that the Great Mother seems entwined with children, Sons of God, and babies? Does that entity have a penchant for offspring?
target: Di immortales, cur videtur Magna Mater cum pueris, Filis Dei, atque infantes implicata esse? Num illa entitas propensionem ad progeniem habet?

source: Lumian smirked superficially.
target: Lumian leviter subridens apparuit.

source: “It seems your Son of God hasn’t truly been born.”
target: “Videtur Filius Dei vester nondum vere natus esse.”

source: The old man in the loose black robe suddenly became fervent.
target: Senex in veste nigra laxae subito fervens factus est.

source: “He’s already born in the spirit world, but He’s yet to step into the real world.”
target: “Iam natus est in mundo spirituali, sed in mundum reale nondum ingressus est.”

source: “Don’t you see? Just revealing His form made me a few years younger. If He were truly born, I’d instantly regain my youth!”
target: “Nonne vides? Solum formam Eius revelare me paucis annis iunior fecit. Si vere natus esset, statim iuventutem meam recipirem!”

source: Who knows what malevolent creation you’ve unleashed… Lumian criticized and said, “You plan to shape the Son of God’s body with just this fragment of life?”
target: “Quis scit quid maleficam creationem effuderas… ” Lumian reprehendit et dixit, “Concipisne corpus Filii Dei ex hoc solum fragmento vitae formare?”

source: The elder was taken aback.
target: Senex obstupefactus est.

source: “This is a ritual bestowed by the Great Mother’s revelation. It’s undeniably effective!”
target: “Hoc est ritus a revelatione Magna Matris donatus. Indubie efficax est!”

source: Lumian smiled.
target: Lumian subridit.

source: “That Enio is unmistakably an ordinary person. The ritual’s effects won’t bode well. If it were a Beyonder with a robust life force, the outcome might be entirely different.”
target: “Enio est indubitanter homo ordinarius. Effectus rituum non optime fore videbuntur. Si esset Beyonder cum vi vitali robusta, exitus omnino diversus foret.”

source: The elder instinctively concurred, “Indeed. That’s why I intended to examine your servant’s internal organs…”
target: Senex instinctive consentivit, “Certe. Ideo intenderam organa interna servi tui explorare…”

source: At this juncture, the elder halted, casting a wary glance at Lumian.
target: In hoc puncto, senex subsedit, et oculos cautelose in Lumian iecit.

source: With a beaming smile, Lumian proposed, “Have you ever thought of sacrificing your own internal organs?”
target: Cum radianti risu, Lumian proposuit: “Num umquam cogitavisti organa interna tua sacrificare?”

source: “If you don’t offer yourself as a sacrifice, how can you showcase your devotion to the Great Mother and your reverence for the Son of God?”
target: “Si teipsum non offeras ut sacrificium, quomodo devotionem tuam erga Magnam Matrem et reverentiam erga Filum Dei ostendere potes?”

source: “Don’t fret; the Son of God will revive you and bestow youth upon you!”
target: “Noli solliciti esse; Filus Dei te revivificabit atque iuventutem tibi donabit!”

source: As he concluded his words, a dark-green light condensed in Lumian’s right hand.
target: Dum verba sua concludebat, lumen viridem fuscum in manu dextra Lumiani condensatum est.
